title: San Francisco Music Box Angus & Friends You're Late Cat Snow Globe #296/1000 LE
conditionDescription: Tested and works - winds and plays. Glass globe clear with no chips or cracks; painted base has no chips.
descriptionText:
San Francisco Music Box Company "Angus & Friends" musical water globe - "You're Late," the Third of Nine Lives in the Angus series by artist Setsuko Broderick, hand-numbered 0296 of 1,000 on the base. Angus the tuxedo cat sits in the glitter globe with his empty red "ANGUS" food bowl and a little yellow chick, waiting for dinner. The resin base is a rooftop scene ringed with cats - tabbies, a black cat, kittens - and a "You're Late" banner on a starry blue background. The music box plays "Food, Glorious Food" from Oliver! (tune on the factory sticker underneath). About 5.5 inches tall.

Condition: Tested and works - winds and plays. Glass globe is clear with no chips or cracks, water is clear with plenty of glitter, and the painted base has no chips. Original San Francisco Music Box label, edition number and caution sticker on the bottom. Please review all photos - they are of the actual globe you will receive.
